standard_responses.title_zh: 百年京张AI创新带城市设计国际方案征集资格预审公告
standard_responses.response_zh: 方案完全依据公告中的三层范围、三处重点区域、设计任务、语言要求和成果深度要求编制，所有空间建议均为概念建议。
standard_responses.response_en: The proposal is fully prepared according to the three-tier scope, three key areas, design tasks, language requirements, and deliverable depth in the announcement; all spatial suggestions are conceptual.

standard_responses.title_zh: 面向全球智能体开展百年京张AI创新带城市设计开源征集任务书摘录
standard_responses.response_zh: 方案覆盖任务书中的三大定位、五大功能、三区两翼、六项必做任务（agent.1-agent.6）、十条共创原则、评审维度和边界条款。
standard_responses.response_en: The proposal covers the three positionings, five functions, three areas-two wings, six required tasks (agent.1-agent.6), ten co-creation principles, review dimensions, and boundary clauses in the taskbook.

standard_responses.response_zh: 方案落实城市设计管理办法要求，统筹平面和立体空间、公共空间、建筑高度体量风格色彩，塑造特色风貌。
standard_responses.response_en: The proposal implements urban design management measures, coordinating planar and three-dimensional space, public space, building height/volume/style/color, and shaping distinctive character.

standard_responses.title_zh: 城市、镇控制性详细规划编制审批办法
standard_responses.response_zh: 方案达到控规深度城市设计要求，但因官方控规条件未公开，容积率、建筑高度等法定控制指标标记为unknown，待正式条件补齐后复算。
standard_responses.response_en: The proposal reaches regulatory-depth urban design requirements, but as official regulatory conditions are not public, statutory control indicators such as FAR and building height are marked as unknown, pending recalculation upon official release.
limitations: Official regulatory conditions not yet published

standard_responses.title_zh: 国土空间调查、规划、用途管制用地用海分类指南
standard_responses.response_zh: 用地布局采用国土空间用地用海分类逻辑，不使用自造分类。
standard_responses.response_en: Land use layout adopts territorial spatial land-sea classification logic, no self-created classifications.

standard_responses.title_zh: 生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法
standard_responses.response_zh: AI场景设计遵循生成式AI服务管理要求，明确隐私边界和人工复核机制。
standard_responses.response_en: AI scenario design follows generative AI service management requirements, with clear privacy boundaries and human review mechanisms.

standard_responses.title_zh: 中华人民共和国无障碍环境建设法
standard_responses.response_zh: 公共空间和公共服务设施设计考虑无障碍要求，保障老年人、儿童和残疾人使用。
standard_responses.response_en: Public space and public service facility design considers accessibility requirements, ensuring use by elderly, children, and disabled persons.

standard_responses.title_zh: 关于切实解决老年人运用智能技术困难实施方案
standard_responses.response_zh: 智慧化改造保留传统服务方式，考虑老年人和数字弱势群体包容性。
standard_responses.response_en: Smart renovation retains traditional service methods, considering inclusiveness for elderly and digitally disadvantaged groups.
